source_text_original: Inside the high court compound Adama Mebrat Hayle Leyu Zone … Tel: 0221125340 … We provide free legal advice and representation to all women and girls, ensuring equitable access to justice across both development and crisis-affected environments.

additional_sources.name: EWLA — Annual Report 2023 (published June 2024)
additional_sources.note: "has opened its regional offices in seven regions and one city administration namely Adama, Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Gambella, Asosa, Jigjiiga, Semera regions and city administration of Dire Dawa."

notes_en: For women and girls. Hours are not stated. Number normalised to international format. The source gives the town only; the region (Oromia) was added for filtering.
notes_am: ለሴቶችና ልጃገረዶች። የሥራ ሰዓት አልተገለጸም። ቁጥሩ ወደ ዓለም አቀፍ ቅርጽ ተቀይሯል። ምንጩ ከተማውን ብቻ ይጠቅሳል፤ ክልሉ (ኦሮሚያ) ለማጣሪያ ተጨምሯል።
